material_representation_tests: Can a public combi version be related to several distinct issuer/product versions without implying identical benefits or legal identity?
Can an owned issued package relate only its actual same-owner issued component contracts and preserve their different insured memberships?
Can a consequence target either component but enumerate all affected package members, under a named versioned condition and supporting original?
Can changing component membership or correcting the triggering receipt invalidate every dependent answer while retaining historical associations?
